changes.before: Initial range/line of effect is not a continuing tether. Loss of concentration or expiry ends this cast’s control immediately. Actual independent Dominate Beast applications retain their own concentration, source histories and instruction priorities; ending one removes only that application. This independent-source completion requires exact review. Existing companion ownership, bond, slot, HP, Load, upkeep, summon duration, recharge and source limits remain. A dominator gains no separate companion budget or new attack profile. When ordinary combat timing matters, use the actual creature/companion sequence; the spell never invents a free pre-initiative attack. Independent-turn Beasts explicitly use the reviewed shared six-second outside-initiative START cadence, with no END saves. Owner-attached companions use only their separately specified bridge. Hard whole-Action/turn components share the combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. Successful establishment claims it once, not per affected turn. Ending, replacing, dispelling or suppressing a hard component never refunds the history. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independently printed components retain their actual defenses. Initial prevention leaves no deferred hard application. Later suppression of an established component preserves its clock and spent history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Compelled ordinary attacks, existing budgets and instruction priority use ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md; the explicitly NEW bindings and companion exceptions use ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md. An ordinary Attack Action includes only its actual inherent attacks/native ordinary Multiattack; ordinary ammunition is spent, but no spellcasting/RP, consumable magic, charges, recharge/per-rest resources, special ammunition with a distinct expendable feature or optional finite riders can be compelled. No direct self-harm, knowingly suicidal route, protected/private secret disclosure, permanent property surrender or knowing binding-oath/duty violation can be commanded. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.

changes.before: Within 10 feet of the anchor, the creature may move normally, including tangentially, but cannot voluntarily move, self-teleport or willingly accept transport beyond that boundary. It cannot choose voluntary transport away from the anchor’s plane; this explicit completion needs exact review. Actual involuntary movement/teleport/hostile transport can move it outside, without snapback. While involuntarily outside on the anchor’s plane, voluntary movement or transport may reduce or preserve its current distance but cannot increase it; once within 10 feet again, the original boundary governs. This applies the same voluntary rule to walking and transport. If involuntarily moved to another plane, the restriction has no cross-planar distance effect while separated; concentration and the original clock continue. Return to the anchor’s plane before expiry resumes the rule against the original anchor.
